pokedexEntries.rb: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.

pokedexEntries.go: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

pokedexEntries.si: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a BODY SLAM.

pokedexEntries.cr: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can’t stop touching it.

pokedexEntries.ru: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes. The surfaces of its eyes are always covered with a thin layer of tears. If any dust gets in this POKéMON’s eyes, it is quickly washed away.

pokedexEntries.sa: WIGGLYTUFF’s body is very flexible. By inhaling deeply, this POKéMON can inflate itself seemingly without end. Once inflated, WIGGLYTUFF bounces along lightly like a balloon.

pokedexEntries.fr: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

pokedexEntries.lg: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

pokedexEntries.em: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a WIGGLYTUFF is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

pokedexEntries.hg: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won’t want to be separated.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Its fine fur feels so pleasant, those who accidentally touch it cannot take their hands away.

pokedexEntries.su: It sheds its fine fur when the seasons change. The fur is gathered and spun into a luxurious yarn.

pokedexEntries.mo: As it inhales, it expands...and expands...and expands. Wigglytuff compete to see which one can inflate itself the most.

pokedexEntries.us: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.

pokedexEntries.um: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!

pokedexEntries.sw: The more air it takes in, the more it inflates. If opponents catch it in a bad mood, it will inflate itself to an enormous size to intimidate them.

pokedexEntries.sh: It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.
